text.en:
Section eight of Act Numbered Twenty-four hundred and eighty-nine, entitled "An Act
authorizing special compensation, credits, and modification in the sentence of prisoners as a reward for
exceptional conduct and workmanship and for other purposes" is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 8. The benefits accruing under this Act shall not be made applicable to any prisoner who has
previously been convicted twice or oftener of any crime or misdemeanor : Provided, however, That recidivists
and habitual delinquents who have observed excellent conduct and behavior for a period of not less than one
year and who have acquired skill in any of the industrial shops of the Bureau of Prisons may receive the
compensation authorized in section one of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 26, 1936.
